design: Fit centered four-state potentials to H957 directed-edge oracle coefficients on each complete factorial quartet. Fixed outputspan .1/top8 bothseeds. Separate MLP/joint and shared-path potentials; raw and common-scaled budget-preserving variants, original directed-edge controls. Both original normbudgets retained. Evaluate every variant on both paths, including cross-path transfer. No model training; all coefficients teacher-informed.
limits: A consistency diagnostic on observed states, not an encoder or unseen-input predictor. Uniform coefficient-space graph projection may sacrifice KL unnecessarily; failure is not a lower bound on consistent KL optimum. Input-state additivity is necessary only for fixed linear decoder representations.
